title: Asking Questions
summary: Ask natural Bengali questions about people, places, time, reasons, methods, quantities, choices, opinions, and confirmation.

vocab.sourcePhrase: এটা কী জন্য ব্যবহার করা হয়?
তুমি সত্যিই কি এটা বিশ্বাস করো?
যদি বৃষ্টি হয় তবে কী হবে?
তুমি চা না কি কফি খাবে?

phrases.en: Who is standing at the door?

words.en: did you see / have you seen

phrases.en: Where do you want to go?

phrases.context: Using কোথায় রাখা (where is it kept)
Using কোথায় পাব (where can I get)

phrases.en: Since when have you been here?
Until when is the store open?
Have you ever been to Dhaka?
How many times have you tried?
How do you like the movie?
phrases.context: Using কেমন লাগছে (how does it feel)

phrases.en: What does the new house look like?
phrases.context: Using কেমন দেখতে (what does it look like)

phrases.en: What kind of food is this?
What type of books do you read?
By what name is your school known?

phrases.bn: এটা কী জন্য ব্যবহার করা হয়?
phrases.pronunciation: eta ki jonno byabohar kora hoy

phrases.context: Using কী বললে (what did you say)
Using কী করা উচিত (what should be done)
Using কী চাই (what do you want)
Using কী পছন্দ (what do you like)

phrases.en: From whom did you receive it?
What time does the train leave?
Which country do you live in?
Which city do you live in?

phrases.context: Using কোথায় বসব (where should I sit)
Using কোথায় যাব (where should I go)
Using কোথায় খাব (where should we eat)
Using কোথায় কিনব (where should I buy)
Using কোথায় শিখব (where should I learn)
Using কখন শুরু (when does it start)
Using কখন শেষ (when does it end)
Using কখন ফিরবে (when will you return)
Using কখন দেখা হবে (when will we meet)

phrases.en: How much money do you have?
How many kilometers away is Dhaka?
How many more minutes will it take?
How long have you been waiting?

phrases.context: Using কেন হবে (why would it happen)

phrases.bn: তুমি সত্যিই কি এটা বিশ্বাস করো?
phrases.pronunciation: tumi shotti-i ki eta bishshash koro

phrases.bn: যদি বৃষ্টি হয় তবে কী হবে?
phrases.pronunciation: jodi brishti hoy tobe ki hobe
phrases.en: If it rains, then what will happen?

phrases.bn: তুমি চা না কি কফি খাবে?
phrases.pronunciation: tumi cha na ki kofi khabe
phrases.en: Will you have tea or coffee?
Was it him or his brother who came?

words.en: did you see / have you seen

phrases.context: Using কী মনে হয় (what do you think)
Using কী ভাবছ (what are you thinking)
Using কী শুনলে (what did you hear)
Using কী দেখলে (what did you see)
Using কী শিখলে (what did you learn)

practice: Say the Bengali words for three items from asking questions.
Read each phrase aloud, then repeat it without looking at the transliteration.
Create a new sentence by replacing one word in a lesson phrase.
notes: Bengali usually keeps the question word where the requested information would appear.
কি can also mark a yes/no question.
